# Agent by Vantik

> Agent by Vantik is a CRM for real estate agents and brokerages in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It keeps prospects, properties, viewings and follow-ups in one place, drafts WhatsApp and email follow-ups that the agent reviews and sends, syncs viewings with Google Calendar or Outlook, and issues commission invoices and property brochures as PDF. Made by Vantik Apps Technology, a software studio based in Dubai (getvantik.com).

Not to be confused with other products named "Vantik" or "Vantix": Agent by Vantik is the real estate CRM at agent.getvantik.com.

## Who it is for

- Independent real estate agents in Dubai (Solo plan)
- Small teams of up to 5 agents (Team plan)
- Brokerages with larger teams (Brokerage plan, custom quote)

## What it does

- Prospect pipeline: log a lead with intent, budget and preferred areas; move it from new lead to contacted, viewing and offer; see who has gone quiet.
- Follow-up drafts: Agent drafts the next WhatsApp or email message from the prospect's history. Nothing is sent automatically; the agent reviews it and sends it from their own WhatsApp or email.
- Calendar: viewings sync with Google Calendar or Outlook, with invites sent to the client.
- Daily routine: a morning email listing follow-ups and viewings, plus push reminders.
- Properties: listings with owner details, branded PDF brochures and share links.
- Invoices: commission invoices as PDF with the agent's logo, with due-date reminders.
- Mobile: installable on iOS and Android home screens, with notifications.

## Pricing (AED, no VAT charged)

- Solo: AED 99/month or AED 999/year (1 agent)
- Team: AED 349/month or AED 3,499/year (up to 5 agents)
- Brokerage: from AED 899/month, custom quote
- Free trial: 14 days, no card required (30 days with a referral code). Cancel anytime; access continues until the end of the paid period.
